name: stale-notice-coverage
summary: One test now pins the stale replay notice in both directions: absent while the item is 有効, present once the model moves under it. No product code changed.

tests.what: creates an item on the sample column, asserts itemValidity is 有効 and the notice is not in the card, then widens section-C1 and asserts itemValidity is 再検討必要 and the notice is. The wording is read with t('ja', 'review.items.staleNotice') rather than written into the test.

both_directions: Asserting only the present case would still pass if the notice were changed to render always; asserting only the absent case would still pass if it never rendered. The test fixes both.

falsifiability.mutation: inverted the render condition to validity.state !== '再検討必要'
falsifiability.observed: 1 failed | 23 passed (24) — 'shows the stale replay notice only while the item needs re-review'

product_defects_found_while_writing_the_: None. The notice's condition was already correct; only the coverage was missing.
authored_by: Claude Opus 5 (direct implementation at the user's instruction, outside the codex harness)
